aboutPage.title: About us
aboutPage.description: Learn more about us and join our events

activitiesPage.description: Join our outreach, picnics, tastings, discussions, trainings, and other healthy and engaging activities.
activitiesPage.otherActivitiesDescription: We want our community to be as open as possible. If you have an idea and want to contribute, please reach out to us on Telegram or via email.
activitiesPage.otherActivitiesImageAlt: People gathered for a community discussion
activitiesPage.otherActivitiesTitle: Food tastings, discussions, trainings, and more
activitiesPage.picnicsDescription: Relaxed community picnics where we connect, share vegan food, and spend time together. Everyone is invited, including non-vegans!
activitiesPage.streetOutreachDescription: Think you can handle the truth? The Challenge invites the public to view a short clip of standard animal agriculture practices in exchange for a vegan treat. If you think it is important to talk with people about vegan ethics and lifestyle, please join us. Action details are in the calendar.
activitiesPage.streetOutreachImageAlt: 3 Minute Movie Challenge street outreach in Chisinau
activitiesPage.digitalProjectsDescription: We are working on digital projects designed to help people in Moldova discover the truth about animal agriculture and to promote a vegan lifestyle online. Our goal is also to bring vegans closer together, creating a more effective force for transformational change in our society.

footer.description: Embrace plant-based living. Every conscious choice builds a healthier planet and a more compassionate future.

veganForAnimalsPage.title: Animal Rights
veganForAnimalsPage.description: Anyone who eats meat participates in animal slaughter through financial support. Animals feel pain, suffering, and fear.

veganForEnvironmentPage.title: Saving the Planet – The Ecological Reason
veganForEnvironmentPage.description: Currently, eating less meat is the most important decision a consumer can make for preserving the environment.

veganForHealthPage.title: Health – The Nutritional Reason
veganForHealthPage.description: A balanced vegetarian diet is healthier and appropriate for both children and adults.
